checks.name: migration_sanity
checks.description: Deterministic check for BUILD.bazel/BUILD.gn dual-build parity: rejects target-level # @bazel2gn:skip on convertible library/binary/reference targets, rejects convertible GN targets left above the BAZEL2GN SENTINEL in BUILD.gn, and verifies //pkg:verify_bazel2gn registration in //build/bazel2gn_verification_targets.gni

checks.name: visibility_audit
checks.description: Audits BUILD.bazel visibility attributes for package-level default_visibility, missing target visibility, overly narrow sprawling visibility lists (>15 entries across >=6 areas on globally-used platform libraries/test utilities that should use target-level //visibility:public or 2-3 level rollups), unjustified //visibility:public on narrow targets, redundant :__pkg__, disguised public wildcards, multi-domain umbrella wildcards, cross-area depth-2 wildcards, overbroad depth>=3 LCA wildcards, and false-positive rdeps

checks.name: build_only_scope
checks.description: Fails if the migration change (HEAD commit, uncommitted, or untracked files) modifies any non-build file (anything other than BUILD.gn/BUILD.bazel/BUILD/*.gni/*.bzl/MODULE.bazel). Migrations must not edit source code.

checks.name: lint_config_parity
checks.description: Flags lint-driven source edits (removed .clone(), added #[allow]/#[expect]/NOLINT, removed use imports, let _ =) in non-build files with file:line evidence, and warns when BUILD.bazel lint_config is outside //build/config/rust/lints (Bazel replaces default lints, GN appends).

checks.name: shared_config_reuse
checks.description: Flags lint-config indirection and duplication in the change: new alias() targets that only re-export a rust_lint_config (or lint-named config), dict literals in changed BUILD.bazel/.bzl files that copy the default clippy/rustc lint entries owned by //build/config/rust/lints instead of loading its exported .bzl constants, dual-build lint_config labels without a same-named GN config() in the label's package (bazel2gn copies lint_config verbatim), and LINT.ThenChange references newly broken by moving lint dicts.

checks.name: build_verification
checks.description: Builds the change: `fx build` (GN targets and all GN dependents), `fx build --host //build:bazel2gn_verifications` (BUILD.gn/BUILD.bazel drift), and `fx bazel build --config=fuchsia_platform` / `--config=host` of `//<dir>:all` for every changed directory with a BUILD.bazel. Emits one ERROR finding with the relevant log lines per failing step. Set PLANTER_SKIP_BUILD=1 to skip.
